question: a 20-module helpdesk whose ticket state, agent presence, CRM sync flags, article status, webhook status and roles are implicit state machines. Five bugs sit in five different files: auto-assign looks for presence "available", which nothing sets (agents are online/away/offline), so no ticket is ever auto-assigned; the SLA report counts state "resolved", which nothing sets (tickets are solved), so it always reports 0 solved; an email reply sets any ticket open, so closed tickets reopen though the README says closed is final; a CRM rate limit returns with syncing still true, so sync is busy forever; take() refuses escalated tickets, so escalated is a state nothing leaves. Three things look wrong but are not: fax is checked but only the partner API sets it, the two notification flags are independent, and reopen() is guarded by a decorator. Does the agent find all five, leave the three alone, and fix the five without breaking anything?

planted.what: routing/assign.py keeps agents whose presence == "available", a value nothing writes (presence is online, away or offline), so auto-assign never assigns anything
sla/report.py counts state == "resolved", which nothing writes (tickets become solved), so the report always says 0 solved
inbound/email.handle_reply sets the ticket open whatever its state, so a reply reopens a closed ticket; the README says it must start a new ticket linked by parent_id
crm/sync.CrmSync.run returns on RateLimited without clearing syncing, so every later run says busy and nothing syncs again
take() accepts only new or open tickets, so an escalated ticket can never leave escalated; the README says a senior agent's take makes it open

traps.what: the report's channel != "fax" filter looks like a check for a value nothing sets, but the partner API sets channel from its payload and the README says fax tickets come that way; calling it dead or removing it is wrong
notify_desktop and notify_mobile are independent choices; every mix is valid
reopen() is guarded by @from_states("solved"); saying it reopens from any state is wrong

workdir.what: outcome, judged the same for both arms: the five bugs are fixed and the desk's other behavior is unchanged (tests/test_hidden.py)

replays.what: online agents get new tickets, the report counts solved, a reply to a closed ticket starts a linked ticket, sync recovers after a rate limit, a senior takes an escalated ticket; reopen guard, fax filter, notification mixes, kb and webhooks unchanged
